findings.message: Codex review of TASK-037 confirms all acceptance criteria are met. Child-safe telemetry dashboards implementation is complete with proper UX, data minimization, and role-safe visibility.
PlayShell integration with KidStatusReadModel provides clear visibility into kid project status and progress, enabling child players to track their achievements.
ParentZoneShell integration with ParentAuditReadModel and AIPerformanceReadModel gives parents comprehensive oversight of audit timeline and AI system performance metrics.
InboundMain properly wires read-model ports into Play and Parent shells, maintaining clean dependency injection and component connectivity throughout the application.
Profile-isolated kid status queries ensure data separation between different player profiles, preventing information leakage between children.

Recursive ad-tech key redaction is properly implemented across all dashboard adapters (kid_status, ai_performance, parent_audit), ensuring analytics excludes ad-tech identifiers and preserves data minimization requirements.
AI performance metrics enhanced with failed_executions and avg_latency_ms, providing better visibility into AI system health. Deterministic fallback ensures robustness.
Comprehensive test coverage: contract tests validate each read model adapter, and integration test validates end-to-end dashboard behavior. All validation scripts pass successfully.
Localization updated with Polish translations for all dashboard UI elements, ensuring consistency with Polish-first language policy.
Review request documentation confirms UX copy, data minimization, and role-safe visibility behavior are all correct and validated.

checklist.data_minimization_compliance: PASS - Data minimization requirements fully met with recursive ad-tech key redaction
checklist.role_safe_visibility: PASS - Role-safe visibility behavior confirmed for kid and parent dashboards
checklist.profile_isolation: PASS - Profile isolation prevents cross-profile data leakage
checklist.test_validation: PASS - All validation scripts (inbound-shell-regression, contract-tests, quality-gates) pass
checklist.localization_compliance: PASS - Polish UI translations complete for dashboard elements

summary: APPROVE. TASK-037 implementation and codex review are both complete and correct. Child-safe telemetry dashboards are fully operational with proper UX, data minimization, and role-safe visibility. All acceptance criteria are met. The copilot cross review confirms all findings and validates the implementation.
